content: We have docs#Manifold.IsImmersionAt.injective_mfderiv and docs#IsDiffImmersionAt.mfderiv_injective . Should one of these be renamed?

The first one should be renamed to mfderiv_injective, if that is the question you had in mind. The naming conventions talk about it explicitly somewhere (I remember since Anatole scolded me once before about this)
If you have a more radical renaming in mind that is for someone else to answer
Sorry, the first name is my oversight; I believe I forgot about this rule. I can file a PR renaming it when back from holiday.
Since I owe you a number of PR reviews, now you just need to click "merge" when you get back from the holidays: #43831 (there were a couple other lemmas to rename as well)
